input.reply:
Thanks for the report. Vitest runs test files as ESM, so `import {fn} from 'libname'` resolves through the package's `import` condition (`index.mjs`). There is no option to switch test execution to CommonJS. I couldn't run searches or check the docs from here, so I haven't confirmed whether an existing issue covers this.

To test the CJS build today, you can point the import at it explicitly:

```ts
// vitest.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
export default defineConfig({
  resolve: { alias: { libname: new URL('./dist/index.cjs', import.meta.url).pathname } },
})
```

Or import it directly in the test with `createRequire(import.meta.url)('libname')`. Setting `resolve.conditions` to `['require']` may also work, but I haven't verified that.

If these don't cover your case, please share a minimal repro (StackBlitz or a repo) and explain why aliasing isn't enough. That will help the team decide whether a config option is worth adding.
